author: supplied by the designer in chat
note: source_photo.png is the photo as sent (720 x 1152). Maps: linear colour per channel divided by a 60 px blur (the photo's dark-to-light lighting gradient removed) and multiplied back by the photo's mean, mirrored 2 x 2 so it repeats without a seam (1440 x 2304). Colour keeps the photo's own oxblood. Height = the luminance relief, softened 1 px, stretched 0.5-99.5 percentile to 0-1. oxblood_leather_normal_gl.png: OpenGL normal map from the height at 35 % of the 0.1 mm render relief (for the GLB). Scale assumed: the photo spans 120 mm, so the tile is 240 mm wide. oxblood_leather_color_glb.jpg: the colour map as JPEG q90, only for the GLB swatch. wine_leather_color.png: the colour map times (0.7606, 0.3947, 1.0072) per linear channel, so its mean is the bordeaux (0.075, 0.006, 0.014), about sRGB #4D121F (facet-fold-v012); wine_leather_color_glb.jpg: the same as JPEG q90 for the GLB swatch.
